notes.title: Regular Demo Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’re committed to keeping the [i]Heaven Does Not Respond[/i] demo fresh and polished. Our team is releasing [b]regular updates[/b] to address feedback, fix bugs, and improve the overall experience based on what players are reporting.[/p][p]If you’ve shared issues or suggestions, thank you. We’re listening closely and working to make each update better than the last.[/p][p]Please make sure to [b]keep your demo updated[/b] so you can enjoy the latest fixes and improvements. Your feedback continues to guide our development, and every report helps us deliver a smoother, more unsettling experience.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and helping us shape the game![/p][p]– Rise Studios[/p]

notes.title: DEMO IS COMING!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We're thrilled to let you know that the demo build for [i]Heaven Does Not Respond[/i] is [b]ready and has been uploaded to Steam[/b]! It's now going through the [b]Steam review process[/b], and once it's approved, it will be available for you to download and play.[/p][p]This is a big step for us, and we can't wait to share this slice of the game with you. Your feedback will be incredibly valuable as we continue development, so once you've had a chance to try it, please let us know what you think![/p][p]🗣️ Join the conversation on our official Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/epZfqy5htB"]https://discord.gg/epZfqy5htB[/url][/p][p]
We're always around and would love to hear your thoughts, suggestions, and bug reports.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your support. Stay tuned, we’re almost there![/p][p]–[i]HDNR Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 We're joining Steam Next Fest this October! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]This marks a huge milestone for us. For the past months, we’ve been pouring our hearts into building something strange, personal, and atmospheric — and now, for the first time, you’ll be able to step into that world yourself.[/p][p]Expect eerie nostalgia, corrupted memories, and unsettling mysteries, all wrapped in a fictional operating system from a 2005 that never quite existed. If you've been following the project or even just curious about it — [b]this is your chance to explore it firsthand[/b].[/p][p]We’d love your support:
📌 [b]Wishlist the game[/b] on Steam
👁️ [b]Follow us[/b] for updates
💾 And mark your calendar — [b]the demo goes live this October[/b].[/p][p]Thank you for being a part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear what you think.
See you in the system.[/p]
